findings.note: Glossary drift inside ui.teamBridge: the namespace already maps “Try again” to “Reintentar” (ui.teamBridge.list.retry), and the attachment chip’s own retry button in this feature is “Reintentar {label}”. So the same action reads two ways a few pixels apart in one message view; “Reintentar” is also shorter in the 144 px placeholder tile.

findings.proposed: Quitar: {label}  /  Reintentar: {label} (or have the call site pass a lowercased label)
findings.note: The call site passes the rendered attachments.position string as {label}, so the visible title tooltip reads “Quitar Imagen 1 de 2”, a common noun capitalised mid-sentence, which breaks the locale’s sentence-case rule. A colon turns it into a label–value pair, where the capital is correct. The root cause is the composition in team-bridge-attachments.tsx (EN has the same shape), so this is a nit, not a translation error.

validation.semantics: I judged each key in its real UI role, read from team-bridge-attachments.tsx (composer chip li aria-label “{position}. {reason}”, remove/retry icon buttons with aria-label and title, the strip ul aria-label, the role=status/alert notice line at 12px, the add icon button whose title is swapped for the limit text when full, the sent-message placeholder tile w-36 with the retry_load link, the in_message group aria-label, and the open thumbnail button), team-bridge-page.tsx and team-bridge-thread-pane.tsx (send_blocked) and team-bridge-scheduled.tsx (remove_all ghost sm Button in the reschedule dialog). Address is tú throughout (Puedes, Usa, Espera, Tienes, Envía, Vuelve, Quítala, Quita) and action labels are infinitives (Añadir, Abrir, Quitar, Reintentar), all in sentence case. Glossary: remove → Quitar, matching compose.remove “Quitar a {name}” and the app-wide “Quitar adjunto”, not Eliminar, because the image leaves the message and nothing is deleted. Upload → subir, add → Añadir (22 uses app-wide, no Agregar), file → archivo, expired → caducada (matching Caducado/caducado app-wide), unavailable → no disponible. Retry in a sentence is “vuelve a intentarlo”, matching schedule.failed and cancel_failed. In send_blocked, “retry” is rendered “vuelve a subir”, which is accurate because that retry re-uploads. unsupported matches the CHANGED en at 0906d747e5 and does not keep the dropped “Only the text was pasted.”. error_offline renders “isn’t reachable” as “no está disponible”, an idiomatic UI rendering of an unanswered local service (context note), and “cuando lo esté” is a correct predicative pronoun. expired_staged and error_quota keep the “retry” path and the uncertainty (“si aún se muestra”). The only drift is retry_load (see finding).
validation.icu: All 23 values parse with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser, and each argument set equals en: {index}+{count} in position and open, {label} in remove and retry, plural {count} in in_message, plural {max} in limit, and none elsewhere. The plurals use exactly the CLDR es arms one/many/other, with no few, and one # in every arm. Formatted with intl-messageformat in es: in_message 0 → “0 imágenes”, 1 → “1 imagen”, 2 → “2 imágenes”, 10 → “10 imágenes”, 1000000 → “1.000.000 de imágenes”, 1500000 → “1.500.000 imágenes”. limit 1 → “Puedes adjuntar hasta 1 imagen por mensaje.”, 1000000 → “…hasta 1.000.000 de imágenes por mensaje.”. Composed remove → “Quitar Imagen 1 de 2”. The file has 169 keys in en order, with nothing missing or extra.
